content.text:
Screen 5: "כמה זה עולה": "דמי ניהול מחיסכון עד 2% בשנה". A percent, sounds small. "דמי יציאה: אין". Good.
Screen 6: orange box: "משיכה לפני הזמן אפשרית, אבל יקרה... הקרן מנכה במקור 47%". 47%! OK, that's the thing: don't touch it before 6 years.
I've got what I came for. Stopping here.

**What I'd tell a friend:**
Basically keep it. A קרן השתלמות is savings that my employer and I both pay into from my salary. After 6 years from the first payment I can take all of it out tax-free. If I take it out earlier they take off up to 47%, so that's out. I'm pretty sure, but not completely. What decided it was the 6 years tax-free plus the 47% orange box. The bit that bugged me was the calculator. It said the keren only leaves "415.84 ₪ יותר" after 10 years. Then it gave ranges with a minus sign ("−342.02 ₪"), which made me wonder if it can come out worse than just investing myself. I didn't figure that part out. My guess is the employer's 7.5% is free money, so it's worth it anyway, but the page didn't hit me over the head with that.

**How it went:** I read the heading and "מה זה" (6 years, tax-free) and "למה משתמשים בזה". On the calculator screen I didn't touch the slider. I left it at 10 years. The top of the result was cut off, so all I saw was 16,935 ₪ and 415.84 ₪. I skipped the small table of עלויות/מס. After that I read the range bullets, then "שווה לדעת" (just the first line), "כסף נכנס ויוצא" (6 years, up to 4 business days), the fees table (2%), and the orange warning on the מיסוי screen. I stopped at "סיכונים ומה לא מוגן". I didn't open any folds or "הצגת החוקים והכללים".

**Words I didn't get:** "הפקדה מוטבת", "הרווח הריאלי", "נאמנות", "ניכוי במקור", the codes like TXH-09 and PF-18, and "מסלול כללי / אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה". I also didn't get why "only 300 ₪" counts and "200 ₪ above it" isn't exempt.

input.answer: Keep the keren hishtalmut: it's money my employer and I put in from my salary, and after 6 years from the first deposit I can take it all out tax-free. If I take it out earlier they deduct up to 47%, so I won't touch it before then. I didn't really get the calculator, which said it only leaves 415.84 ₪ more and showed a range with a minus.

stuck.why: The result is split across the scroll. All I saw was 16,935 ₪ cut off at the top and 'משאירה 415.84 ₪ יותר', which felt tiny for 10 years, and I couldn't tell what the bars were.
It sounded like part of my deposit isn't tax-free after all. That contradicts 'הכול בפטור ממס' at the top and confused me.
The minus made me think the keren can come out worse than the alternative, and nothing told me when.
